--[[
	EmitAt  -  mixin: Particle:EnableEmitAt (one item) and Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt (item + descendants),
	the origin-override emits. Both return a PlayHandle scoped to the call.
]]

local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local PlayHandle = require(script.Parent.PlayHandle)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.EventsSchema)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local _Duration = require(script.Parent.Duration)

-- Warn once per key: rejected calls and in-place fallbacks are authoring errors, not per-frame noise.
local warned = {}
local function warnOnce(key, message)
	if warned[key] then return end
	warned[key] = true
	Log.warn(message)
end

-- A node that cannot take an origin still emits in place. EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason is the
-- single source shared with Events/EmitTarget.
local function warnInPlace(node)
	local reason = EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(node)
	if not reason then return end
	warnOnce(node.ClassName .. ":" .. tostring(node:GetAttribute("EmissionMode")),
		("[Part-Icles] EmitAt: %s emits in place: %s"):format(node:GetFullName(), reason))
end

-- Origin forms: CFrame as given; Vector3 = position only (the emitter keeps its rotation); an
-- instance with a frame (BasePart / Model / Attachment / Bone / Camera) = its live frame, re-read
-- at spawn so a delayed emit follows it. Returns cf, resolver, fullPose; or nil, reason.
local function resolveOrigin(origin, options)
	local kind = typeof(origin)
	local fullPose = options.UseFullOrigin ~= false
	if kind == "CFrame" then return origin, options.OriginResolver, fullPose end
	if kind == "Vector3" then return CFrame.new(origin), options.OriginResolver, false end
	if kind == "Instance" and (origin:IsA("PVInstance") or origin:IsA("Attachment") or origin:IsA("Camera")) then
		local resolver = options.OriginResolver or function()
			if origin.Parent == nil then return nil end
			return Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(origin)
		end
		return Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(origin), resolver, fullPose
	end
	local got = kind == "Instance" and origin.ClassName or kind
	return nil, ("origin must be a CFrame, a Vector3 or an instance with a position (got %s)"):format(got)
end

-- The play's link: "camera" or an Instance. nil when absent, or when Persist writes it to the source.
local function playLink(options)
	if options.Persist == true then return nil end
	local link = options.Link
	if link == "camera" then return workspace.CurrentCamera end
	if typeof(link) == "Instance" then return link end
	return nil
end

-- Per-play overrides carried on emitCtx.Overrides: EnableEmit reads Count / Delay / Duration,
-- GetEmitData reads LinkMode / EmitParent. Nothing is written to the source item.
local function buildOverrides(options)
	local overrides = {}
	if options.Persist ~= true then
		if options.LinkMode ~= nil then
			overrides.LinkMode = options.LinkMode
		elseif options.Link ~= nil then
			overrides.LinkMode = "Weld"
		end
		if options.EmitParent ~= nil then overrides.EmitParent = options.EmitParent end
	end
	if typeof(options.Count) == "number" then overrides.Count = options.Count end
	if typeof(options.Delay) == "number" then overrides.Delay = options.Delay end
	if options.Duration ~= nil then overrides.Duration = options.Duration end
	if next(overrides) == nil then return nil end
	return overrides
end

-- Persist = true: write Link / EmitParent onto the source as authored state.
local function persistAuthoring(self, node, options)
	if options.Link ~= nil then self:SetLink(node, options.Link, options.LinkMode or "Weld") end
	if options.EmitParent ~= nil then self:SetEmitParent(node, options.EmitParent) end
end

return function(Particle)

-- Shared per-call state for both entry points; nil (after a warning) when the call is rejected.
local function beginPlay(self, item, origin, options, apiName)
	self:_warnIfNotActivated(apiName)
	options = options or {}
	if not item or not item.Parent then
		warnOnce(apiName .. ":item", ("[Part-Icles] %s: item is nil or has no parent; nothing emitted."):format(apiName))
		return nil
	end
	local originCF, resolver, fullPose = resolveOrigin(origin, options)
	if not originCF then
		warnOnce(apiName .. ":" .. tostring(resolver), ("[Part-Icles] %s: %s; nothing emitted."):format(apiName, tostring(resolver)))
		return nil
	end
	local overrides = buildOverrides(options)
	local totalDur = _Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0, overrides)
	-- Per-play "ghost": every particle spawned by THIS call carries token; the returned
	-- PlayHandle scopes Disable / SetTimescale / GetParticles to this play, not the shared
	-- source. token.Loops collects continuous-loop tasks; token.Clones collects branch-B
	-- raw clones. Threaded via emitCtx._playToken → _registerEmit stamps each pData.
	local token = { Alive = true, Loops = {}, Clones = {}, Duration = totalDur }
	return {
		options = options,
		originCF = originCF,
		resolver = resolver,
		fullPose = fullPose,
		overrides = overrides,
		token = token,
		handle = PlayHandle.new(self, token),
		totalDur = totalDur,
		link = playLink(options),
		-- LinkOverride: spawn at the LIVE link CFrame and ignore the origin, so a delayed / moving-link
		-- emit follows the link instead of trailing at the call-time origin.
		linkWins = options.LinkOverride == true and options.Link ~= nil,
	}
end

-- emitCtx for one node; `originCF` / `resolver` are that node's own (offset for containers).
local function buildCtx(play, originCF, resolver)
	local options = play.options
	local ctx = {
		ChainCtx      = options.ChainCtx,
		UseFullOrigin = play.fullPose,
		-- A play link beats IgnoreLink (Events set IgnoreLink with no link of their own).
		IgnoreLink    = options.IgnoreLink == true and play.link == nil,
		EventDriven   = options.EventDriven == true,
		Overrides     = play.overrides,
		_playToken    = play.token,
		_playLink     = play.link,
	}
	-- linkWins drops the origin so Emit's link branch spawns at the live link.
	if not play.linkWins then
		ctx.EventOriginCF = originCF
		ctx.EventOriginResolver = resolver
	end
	return ctx
end

-- Transformed root: persist authoring when asked, then fire the engine pipeline.
local function emitTransformedRoot(self, item, play)
	warnInPlace(item)
	if play.options.Persist == true then persistAuthoring(self, item, play.options) end
	self:EnableEmit(item, play.link, buildCtx(play, play.originCF, play.resolver))
	return play.handle, play.totalDur
end

-- One transformed item at an origin. Options and returns as AbsoluteEmitAt; containers are its job.
function Particle:EnableEmitAt(item, origin, options)
	local play = beginPlay(self, item, origin, options, "EnableEmitAt")
	if not play then return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0 end
	if not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		warnOnce("EnableEmitAt:" .. item.ClassName, ("[Part-Icles] EnableEmitAt: %s is not a Part-Icle; use AbsoluteEmitAt for containers and raw emitters. Nothing emitted."):format(item:GetFullName()))
		return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0
	end
	return emitTransformedRoot(self, item, play)
end

-- Recursive :EnableEmitAt. Two-pass hybrid:
--
-- (A) `item` IS a transformed Part-Icle:
--   Emit via the existing engine pipeline with origin override threaded through
--   emitCtx. No clone of the source  -  engine handles nested transformed descendants
--   automatically via the standard emit pipeline.
--
-- (B) `item` is a non-transformed 3D container (BasePart / Model / Attachment):
--   Pass 1  -  every transformed Part-Icle descendant emits via engine pipeline with
--   per-node origin override (its authored offset from the container pivot, carried into
--   the origin). NO clone of any transformed item. Each Part-Icle's 60+ attributes /
--   RenderTemplate stay in place; only the engine's per-emit Pool.acquireOrClone is invoked.
--   Pass 2  -  clone the container WITHOUT its transformed descendants (stripped from
--   the clone) so only the non-transformed parts + raw PE / Trail / Beam survive.
--   Anchor + PivotTo the clone to the origin, parent into emit folder, fire raw
--   native dispatch on the clone, scheduled destroy after the clone's own duration.
--
-- Result: transformed Part-Icles use the lightweight engine-level origin override
-- (no 60+ attribute copy). Raw native emitters get their proper clone-and-place
-- treatment. Repeated calls are independent (each call clones a fresh raw subtree).
--
-- origin: CFrame; Vector3 (position only); or an instance with a frame, followed live.
--
-- options (optional table):
--   ChainCtx            event-chain context
--   OriginResolver      function() -> CFrame, evaluated at spawn time (live origin). On a
--                       container it is re-resolved per node so the layout survives EmitDelay
--   UseFullOrigin       bool; true carries the container layout + rotation into the origin
--                       (AtCFrame); false translates only, every node keeps its own rotation.
--                       Default true (a Vector3 origin is always position only)
--   IgnoreLink          bool; bypass authored Link. Default false. A play Link wins over it
--   Link                Instance or "camera"; every emitter this call fires links to it for
--                       this play only. nil = authored Link
--   LinkMode            string; "Follow" / "Pivot" / "Weld" / "WeldWithoutRotation" / "RigidLocal".
--                       Defaults to "Weld" when Link is set and LinkMode omitted
--   EmitParent          Instance; where this play's clones parent, this play only
--   Count / Delay / Duration
--                       per-play EmitCount / EmitDelay / EmitDuration for every transformed
--                       emitter this call fires (Duration takes a number or "min,max"); raw
--                       ParticleEmitters and nested emitters inside RenderTemplates keep theirs
--   Persist             bool; write Link / LinkMode / EmitParent onto the source with SetLink /
--                       SetEmitParent instead of keeping them per play. Default false
--   ApplyToAll          bool; with Persist on a container, also write Link / EmitParent to every
--                       transformed descendant. Default false
--   LinkOverride        bool; with Link set, spawn at the LIVE link CFrame (central) and
--                       ignore the origin. Fixes a delayed / moving-link emit trailing at the
--                       call-time origin. Collapses a multi-node container to the link center
--   EventDriven         bool; Events dispatch. EnableEmit floors EmitCount 0 to one burst
--
-- Returns the PlayHandle (inert after a rejected call, never nil) and the total real-time
-- duration (nil for infinite). Pair with handle:Wait() or .await(duration).
function Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt(item, origin, options)
	local play = beginPlay(self, item, origin, options, "AbsoluteEmitAt")
	if not play then return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0 end
	options = play.options
	local originCF = play.originCF
	local fullPose = play.fullPose
	local token = play.token
	local handle = play.handle
	local totalDur = play.totalDur

	-- (A) Transformed root.
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		return emitTransformedRoot(self, item, play)
	end

	-- Raw Trail / Beam roots have no frame of their own: fire in place.
	if item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
		self:_absoluteEmitFire(item, nil, nil)
		return handle, totalDur
	end

	-- (B) Non-transformed 3D container (or a raw ParticleEmitter): hybrid two-pass.
	if not (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) then
		warnOnce("AbsoluteEmitAt:" .. item.ClassName, ("[Part-Icles] AbsoluteEmitAt: %s has no position; pass a Part / Model / Attachment / ParticleEmitter or a transformed item. Nothing emitted."):format(item:GetFullName()))
		return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0
	end

	-- Snapshot anchorCF so per-node origin (Pass 1) + clone reposition (Pass 2) both
	-- reference the same authored pivot baseline.
	local anchorCF
	if item:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, p = pcall(item.GetPivot, item); if ok then anchorCF = p end
	elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then anchorCF = item.CFrame
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then anchorCF = item.WorldCFrame
	elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		-- A raw emitter borrows its host's frame so the holder inherits the authored rotation.
		local host = item.Parent
		if host and host:IsA("BasePart") then anchorCF = host.CFrame
		elseif host and host:IsA("Attachment") then anchorCF = host.WorldCFrame end
	end

	local function readWorldCF(it)
		if it:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(it.GetPivot, it); return ok and cf or nil end
		if it:IsA("Attachment") then return it.WorldCFrame end
		if it:IsA("BasePart") then return it.CFrame end
		return nil
	end

	-- Node origin inside `base`: full pose carries the authored layout into the origin frame;
	-- position-only translates it so every node keeps its own rotation (mirrors
	-- Events/EmitTarget.childOrigin; Pass 2 places the raw clone the same way).
	local function originFor(base, node)
		if not anchorCF then return base end
		local nodeCF = readWorldCF(node)
		if not nodeCF then return base end
		if fullPose then return base * anchorCF:ToObjectSpace(nodeCF) end
		return nodeCF + (base.Position - anchorCF.Position)
	end

	local function ctxFor(node)
		local resolver = play.resolver
		local nodeResolver
		if resolver then
			-- Re-resolve per node: a bare resolver would collapse every node onto the
			-- container origin once EmitDelay passes.
			nodeResolver = function()
				local live = resolver()
				if not live then return nil end
				return originFor(live, node)
			end
		end
		return buildCtx(play, originFor(originCF, node), nodeResolver)
	end

	-- Persist with ApplyToAll (or LinkOverride): write Link / EmitParent onto every transformed
	-- descendant before Pass 1 so each leaf's GetData read picks up the authoring.
	if options.Persist == true and (options.ApplyToAll or play.linkWins) then
		local function applyAuthoring(node)
			if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then persistAuthoring(self, node, options) end
			for _, child in node:GetChildren() do applyAuthoring(child) end
		end
		applyAuthoring(item)
	end

	-- Pass 1: per-node origin override for transformed Part-Icles on the ORIGINAL.
	-- Walks down stopping at each transformed leaf (engine pipeline recurses inside
	-- the leaf's RenderTemplate during emit, so we don't recurse past it ourselves).
	local function walkTransformed(node)
		if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			warnInPlace(node)
			self:EnableEmit(node, play.link, ctxFor(node))
			return
		end
		for _, child in node:GetChildren() do
			walkTransformed(child)
		end
	end
	walkTransformed(item)

	-- Internal SkipClone path: caller owns the cloneRoot lifecycle (pool acquire +
	-- positioning + release). Skip Pass 2's clone+anchor+pivot+destroy block; fire
	-- raw native PE/Trail/Beam descendants in-place on the caller's pre-positioned
	-- subtree. Events/EmitTarget.luau uses this so its pool reuse + Folder/PE wrappers stay
	-- intact while still picking up Pass 1's per-node origin override semantics.
	if options.SkipClone then
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(item, self:_makeAliveCheck())
		return handle, totalDur
	end

	-- Pass 2: detect raw native emitters not covered by Pass 1. Skip Pass 2 entirely
	-- when nothing raw exists (saves the clone cost for pure Part-Icle containers).
	local function _underTransformedAncestor(desc)
		local cur = desc.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= item do
			if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local hasRawEmitter = item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
	for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
		if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
			and not _underTransformedAncestor(desc) then
			hasRawEmitter = true; break
		end
	end
	if not hasRawEmitter then return handle, totalDur end

	local ok, clone = pcall(item.Clone, item)
	if not ok or not clone then return handle, totalDur end
	pcall(function() clone.Archivable = false end)

	-- Strip transformed descendants from the clone (Pass 1 fired them on the
	-- original; keeping them in the clone would double-fire + waste the clone of
	-- their 60+ attributes).
	for _, desc in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end) end
	end
	-- The stripped clone holds only raw emitters, so its own window bounds the destroy
	-- (the container total can be nil through an infinite transformed sibling).
	local cloneDur = _Duration.computeMaxDuration(clone, 0) or 60

	-- Anchor every remaining BasePart in the clone so PivotTo holds.
	if clone:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() clone.Anchored = true end) end
	for _, desc in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() desc.Anchored = true end) end
	end

	-- Compute target CFrame. UseFullOrigin=true → the origin as-is. UseFullOrigin=false
	-- → use the origin's position with the container's authored rotation.
	local targetCF = originCF
	if not fullPose and anchorCF then
		targetCF = CFrame.new(originCF.Position) * anchorCF.Rotation
	end
	if clone:IsA("Model") then
		pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(targetCF) end)
	elseif clone:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- PivotTo carries descendant parts along; the PivotOffset term lands the part's own
		-- CFrame (the anchor baseline) on targetCF.
		pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(targetCF * clone.PivotOffset) end)
	else
		-- Attachment / ParticleEmitter roots ride an invisible holder Part placed at targetCF.
		local holder = Instance.new("Part")
		holder.Name = "_EmitHolder"
		holder.Anchored = true
		holder.CanCollide = false
		holder.CanQuery = false
		holder.CanTouch = false
		holder.Massless = true
		holder.Transparency = 1
		holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
		holder.Archivable = false
		-- Box-shaped emitters keep their authored emission area.
		if clone:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and item.Parent and item.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			holder.Size = item.Parent.Size
		end
		holder.CFrame = targetCF
		if clone:IsA("Attachment") then clone.CFrame = CFrame.new() end
		clone.Parent = holder
		clone = holder
	end

	clone.Parent = self:GetFolder()
	-- Track the raw clone on the play so PlayHandle:Disable tears it down early.
	table.insert(token.Clones, clone)
	-- Fire raw dispatch on the stripped clone. Transformed branch in _absoluteEmitFire
	-- is unreachable post-strip; only the raw PE / Trail / Beam / native-walk branches fire.
	self:_absoluteEmitFire(clone, nil, nil)

	task.delay(cloneDur, function()
		if clone and clone.Parent then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end) end
	end)

	return handle, totalDur
end

end

--[[
	EmitAttachment Mixin  -  one-shot emit for Attachment particles, split from Emit.luau for the
	500-line cap. Composes in the nearest BasePart ancestor's space; motion math shared with
	Motion Preview via PreSimulateAttachmentForward.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local NestedScale = require(script.Parent.NestedScale)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- Walk up the parent chain to find the nearest BasePart. Attachment nested inside
-- Attachment(s) must compose through ancestors; we anchor the visual to the first
-- BasePart so its parent-local CFrame math behaves consistently with sibling-emit types.
local function _findBasePartAncestor(inst)
	local p = inst.Parent
	while p do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

return function(Particle)

-- Attachment variant  -  sim runs in parent-BasePart-local space. DirMode 3-way split:
-- Local = post-RotXYZ; Global = world axis rebased; RigidLocal = pre-RotXYZ.
function Particle:EmitAttachment(attachment, link, emitCtx)
	if not attachment or not attachment.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(attachment, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		link = nil
	else
		link = link or data.Link
	end

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	-- Source world pose composes the full chain (Attachment-in-Attachment-in-BasePart).
	-- WorldCFrame is the only correct read when parent is non-BasePart; .CFrame alone
	-- yields parent-local relative to a non-BasePart frame that breaks compose math.
	local sourceWorldCF = attachment.WorldCFrame
	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)
	local worldCF
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		if not originOverrideCF then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF end
	end
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			worldCF = originOverrideCF -- AtCFrame: full source orientation
		else
			worldCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * sourceWorldCF.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		worldCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, attachment, sourceWorldCF, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
	else
		worldCF = sourceWorldCF
	end
	-- Visual parent, in priority: EmitParent (user intent) > the parent clone's copy of the source's
	-- BasePart ancestor (nested) > a carrier mirroring the source's BasePart ancestor (top-level, keeps
	-- parent-relative motion without parenting into the user's part) > the world carrier (a source
	-- with no part above it; never the live folder, where the visual would ride the camera).
	-- All downstream local-space math runs in actualParent-local.
	local actualParent = data.EmitParent or NestedEmit.resolveCloneParent(attachment, link, emitCtx)
	local carrier = nil
	if not actualParent then
		local anchor = _findBasePartAncestor(attachment)
		if anchor then
			carrier = VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
			actualParent = carrier
		else
			actualParent = VisualHost.worldCarrier()
		end
	end
	local actualParentCF = (actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart")) and actualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	local localCF = actualParentCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]

	-- Initial rotation (always applied)
	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	-- Initial RotX/Y/Z compose through RotOrder; see EmitPart for the rationale.
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	local rotatedLocalCF = localCF * rotXYZ

	-- Base direction (3-way: Local / RigidLocal / Global). Sim frame is parent-local.
	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = rotatedLocalCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		-- World-space axis converted to actualParent-local (handles nested-Attachment via
		-- the BasePart anchor we walked up to). Folder-anchored fallback stays world-space.
		local worldAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		if actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart") then
			baseDirection = actualParent.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(worldAxis)
		else
			baseDirection = worldAxis
		end
	else -- RigidLocal: pre-RotXYZ pose in actualParent-local
		baseDirection = localCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	end

	localCF = rotatedLocalCF

	-- simFrameCF = actualParentCF so applyPositionOffset converts world offset into
	-- actualParent-local space (matches our sim frame after the BasePart walk-up).
	-- posScale: scale the spawn Pos spread by the parent Model's scale at this emit moment.
	local posScale = 1
	local psInfo = emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale
	if psInfo and psInfo.ScaleMotion ~= false then
		posScale = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(psInfo, os.clock(), GraphMod)
	end
	localCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(localCF, data, link, attachment, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, actualParentCF, posScale)

	-- Global: apply inv(actualParent.Rotation) so parent cancels at engine-multiply,
	-- leaving rotXYZ alone. Uses actualParent (BasePart anchor) so nested-Attachment
	-- sources don't fall to identity here.
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		if actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart") then
			localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * actualParent.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * rotXYZ
		else
			localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * rotXYZ
		end
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX),
		RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY),
		RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	-- Aliases: RotSpeed only (no Size on Attachments).
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil

	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, localCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, Time, nil, localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse())
	end

	local visualAttachment = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Attachment", data.Pool)
	visualAttachment.Archivable = false
	-- Nested in a Model: the copy's own attachments and beams take the Model's scale (NestedScale); UpdateAttachment keeps them to it.
	local scaledContent = psInfo and NestedScale.start(visualAttachment, psInfo, Constants.getParentScaleFactor(psInfo, os.clock(), GraphMod))

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
	end

	-- actualParent + actualParentCF computed earlier (before sim) so PreSimulate
	-- and rotation/shape compose operate in the right frame.

	visualAttachment.CFrame = localCF
	visualAttachment.Parent = actualParent
	-- Sibling Beams / Trails bind their ends to this visual: transformed ones when they emit
	-- (NestedEmit fires Attachment leaves first), stock ones in the parent copy right here
	-- (Pool.registerEmitted).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap then Pool.registerEmitted(emitCtx._parentCloneMap, attachment, visualAttachment) end

	-- Restore nested-Trail Enabled snapshot after Parent so they track from spawn pose.
	-- Mirrors the Part path at line ~273.
	Pool.restoreTrails(visualAttachment, "Attachment")

	-- pData.LocalCF in parentCF_now-local space (link path) or actualParent-local (unlinked).
	local pDataLocalCF = localCF
	if link then
		pDataLocalCF = LinkCF.emitAttachmentParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, actualParent, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, sourceWorldCF):ToObjectSpace(localCF)
	end

	-- RigidLocal: snapshot link's WORLD CFrame at emit. Per-frame Attachment Link
	-- consumers convert this to visualParent-local at sample time so a moving
	-- visualParent stays correct.
	local rigidLocalSnapshot = LinkCF.rigidWorldSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, sourceWorldCF)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Attachment",
		VisualPart = visualAttachment,
		_carrier = carrier,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = rigidLocalSnapshot,
		Events = data.Events,

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time,
		PartLife = data.PartLife,
		LocalCF = pDataLocalCF,
		_localWorldCF = pDataLocalCF, -- seed for LinkTrack frame 0
		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0, _spinAccumY = 0, _spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory graph state (see Part emit above for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = pDataLocalCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = pDataLocalCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Attachment has no Size; 1.0 fallback for the sleep point-velocity check.
		_sleepRadius = 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,

		Graphs = {
			Speed = data.Speed,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
	}

	-- 1-frame pop prevention for PosOffset (see EmitPart for semantics).
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	pData._sourceItem = attachment
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, attachment)
	-- Nested-Model scale: attachment particles also read the parent's scale (motion/rotation).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
		pData._scaledContent = scaledContent
	end
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Attachment" end
	-- Static-graph short-circuit: constant-valued graphs nil out + stamp pData._static<Name>.
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	for _, desc in visualAttachment:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then desc.Enabled = false end
	end
	self:_adoptIntoContainer(pData, emitCtx)
	local aliveAtt = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualAttachment:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, aliveAtt) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, aliveAtt)
	end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: source-walk; link = visualAttachment drives position.
	-- The inherited Model-scale chain node is forwarded to deeper nested particles.
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, visualAttachment, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, pData.ParentScale)
end

end

--[[
	EmitModel Mixin  -  Emit + Animate for Model emitters.
	Whole-model clone, :PivotTo for position, :ScaleTo for size (cascades to children).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local AtRest = require(script.Parent.AtRest)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

return function(Particle)

-- One-shot Model emit. Pivot = model:GetPivot; mirrors EmitPart minus shape geometry.
function Particle:EmitModel(model, link, emitCtx)
	if not model or not model.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(model, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		link = nil
	else
		link = link or data.Link
	end

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	-- Event-origin override replaces pivot position; preserves authored rotation.
	local pivotCF = model:GetPivot()
	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		if not originOverrideCF then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF end
	end
	local unrotatedCF
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			unrotatedCF = originOverrideCF -- AtCFrame: full source CFrame
		else
			unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * pivotCF.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		unrotatedCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, model, pivotCF, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
	else
		unrotatedCF = pivotCF
	end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	local initialCF = unrotatedCF

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ

	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, model, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx)

	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end

	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX),
		RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY),
		RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		Scale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Scale),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil

	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, Time, nil, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(), emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes and model:GetPivot() or nil)
	end

	local visualModel = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Model", data.Pool)
	visualModel.Archivable = false
	-- Pool reuse can carry over the prior cycle's final ScaleTo value. Snapshot the
	-- authored RT scale once + restore before the graph-driven ScaleTo writes its t=0
	-- value below so the visible state never reflects a stale scale, even for one frame.
	do
		local rt = data.RenderTemplate
		if rt and visualModel:GetAttribute("_pooledModelScale") == nil then
			local ok, s = pcall(function() return rt:GetScale() end)
			if ok and s then visualModel:SetAttribute("_pooledModelScale", s) end
		end
		local priorScale = visualModel:GetAttribute("_pooledModelScale")
		if priorScale then pcall(function() visualModel:ScaleTo(priorScale) end) end
	end
	local parentCF_now = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, model:GetPivot())
	local localCF

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
		visualModel:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)
	else
		localCF = link and parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(initialCF) or initialCF
		visualModel:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Model",
		VisualPart = visualModel,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, parentCF_now),
		Events = data.Events,

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time,
		PartLife = data.PartLife,
		CurrentPosition = visualModel:GetPivot().Position,
		LocalCF = localCF,

		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0, _spinAccumY = 0, _spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		_localWorldCF = localCF,

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory graph state (see Emit.luau Part path for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Model has no .Size; 1.0 fallback for sleep point-velocity check.
		_sleepRadius = 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,

		Graphs = {
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Speed = data.Speed, Scale = data.Scale,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
	}

	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() + worldOff)
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	-- Cache descendant Beams for Segments clamp after ScaleTo.
	local vBeams = {}
	for _, desc in visualModel:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("Beam") and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then table.insert(vBeams, desc) end
	end
	if #vBeams > 0 then pData._visualBeams = vBeams end

	-- Inherit the parent-Model scale chain (nil for a top-level Model) so this Model's own
	-- visual AND its nested children compound with every ancestor Model's scale.
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
	end

	-- 1-frame pop prevention. Compound the frame-0 scale with the inherited chain.
	local startScale = math.max(0.001, GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale))
	startScale = startScale * Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, pData.StartTime, GraphMod)
	visualModel:ScaleTo(startScale)
	for _, beam in ipairs(vBeams) do if beam.Segments < 20 then beam.Segments = 20 end end

	-- Carried by a Matte: the copy's parts are windows in its layer (Matte/init).
	self:_matteCarry(emitCtx, pData, nil, "Pivot")
	visualModel.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	-- Restore pooled Trails AFTER PivotTo + Parent so trails track from spawn, not pool pose.
	Pool.restoreTrails(visualModel, "Model")

	for _, desc in visualModel:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then desc.Enabled = false end
	end
	self:_adoptIntoContainer(pData, emitCtx)
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, desc in visualModel:GetDescendants() do
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(desc, alive)
	end

	pData._sourceItem = model
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, model)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Model" end
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Nested Part-Icles: source-walk (NestedEmit.luau); each leaf inherits this Model's scale node.
	-- Chain node children inherit (PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor reads Owner._ownScale).
	local parentScaleInfo = {
		Owner = pData,
		-- nil/true → scale Beam.TextureLength with model scale (preserves tile count).
		-- false → leave authored TextureLength alone (tiles repeat more as beam grows).
		ScaleTextureLength = data.ScaleTextureLength ~= false,
		-- Nested-particle motion scaling (Speed/Accel/PosOffset/Pos) + rotation (opt-in).
		ScaleMotion = data.ScaleMotion ~= false,
		ScaleRotation = data.ScaleRotation == true,
		-- Chain to this Model's own inherited scale so nested children compound up the tree.
		Parent = pData.ParentScale,
	}
	pData._scaleNode = parentScaleInfo
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, visualModel, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, parentScaleInfo)
end

-- Model Animate. LIVE source RT (no clone). AnimateLoop re-runs with fresh data.
function Particle:EmitModelAnimate(model, link, emitCtx)
	if not model or not model.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(model, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	link = link or data.Link

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	local visualModel = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone
	local initialAnchorCF = visualModel:GetPivot()
	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)

	local unrotatedCF = model:GetPivot()
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	local initialCF = unrotatedCF

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ

	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, model, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx)

	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end

	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX),
		RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY),
		RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		Scale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Scale),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil
	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, Time, nil, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(), emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes and model:GetPivot() or nil)
	end

	local parentCF_now = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, model:GetPivot())
	local localCF
	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
	else
		localCF = link and parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(initialCF) or initialCF
	end
	visualModel:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Model",
		VisualPart = visualModel,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, parentCF_now),
		Events = data.Events,

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0, AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		CurrentPosition = visualModel:GetPivot().Position,
		LocalCF = localCF,

		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0, _spinAccumY = 0, _spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		_localWorldCF = localCF,

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory graph state (see Emit.luau Part path for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Model has no .Size; 1.0 fallback for sleep point-velocity check.
		_sleepRadius = 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,

		Graphs = {
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Speed = data.Speed, Scale = data.Scale,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),

		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = model,
		InitialAnchorCF = initialAnchorCF, InitialLocalCF = localCF,
		-- Snapshot scale so finishAnimate / cancelAnimation restore authored value.
		InitialScale = (function() local ok, s = pcall(function() return model:GetScale() end); return ok and s or 1 end)(),
	}

	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() + worldOff)
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	local vBeams = {}
	for _, desc in visualModel:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("Beam") and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then table.insert(vBeams, desc) end
	end
	if #vBeams > 0 then pData._visualBeams = vBeams end

	-- Inherit + compound the parent-Model scale chain (see EmitModel normal path).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
	end
	local startScale = math.max(0.001, GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale))
	startScale = startScale * Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, pData.StartTime, GraphMod)
	visualModel:ScaleTo(startScale)
	for _, beam in ipairs(vBeams) do if beam.Segments < 20 then beam.Segments = 20 end end

	-- LIVE source, no pre-disable; EnableEmitSingle handles each descendant.
	local aliveAnim = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, desc in visualModel:GetDescendants() do
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(desc, aliveAnim)
	end

	pData._sourceItem = model
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, model)
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self.ActiveAnimates[model] = pData
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	if self.ActiveAnimates[model] == pData then AtRest.wake(visualModel) end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: each leaf inherits this Model's scale node.
	-- Chain node children inherit (PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor reads Owner._ownScale).
	local parentScaleInfo = {
		Owner = pData,
		-- nil/true → scale Beam.TextureLength with model scale (preserves tile count).
		-- false → leave authored TextureLength alone (tiles repeat more as beam grows).
		ScaleTextureLength = data.ScaleTextureLength ~= false,
		-- Nested-particle motion scaling (Speed/Accel/PosOffset/Pos) + rotation (opt-in).
		ScaleMotion = data.ScaleMotion ~= false,
		ScaleRotation = data.ScaleRotation == true,
		-- Chain to this Model's own inherited scale so nested children compound up the tree.
		Parent = pData.ParentScale,
	}
	pData._scaleNode = parentScaleInfo
	NestedEmit.walk(self, visualModel, visualModel, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, parentScaleInfo)
end

end

--[[
	EmitOverrides  -  Particle:GetEmitData: GetData plus the play's overrides (emitCtx.Overrides from
	EmitAt options). LinkMode and EmitParent replace the authored values on the fresh data table, so
	nothing is written to the source. Emit paths that read Link / LinkMode / EmitParent call this;
	types without link semantics keep GetData. EnableEmit applies Count / Delay / Duration itself.
]]

return function(Particle)

-- Fresh data table for `item` with the play's LinkMode / EmitParent applied.
function Particle:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	local overrides = emitCtx and emitCtx.Overrides
	if not data or not overrides then return data end
	if overrides.LinkMode ~= nil then data.LinkMode = overrides.LinkMode end
	if overrides.EmitParent ~= nil then data.EmitParent = overrides.EmitParent end
	return data
end

end

--[[
	EmitterBursts  -  Burst mode of a native ParticleEmitter (attribute EmitMode = "Burst"):
	EmitCount particles every 1 / Rate seconds for EmitDuration, in place of one burst and an
	enabled window.
	  EmitterBursts.start(emitter, count, duration, stillCurrent)
	      fires the first burst now and keeps the train going for `duration` seconds;
	      stillCurrent() -> false ends it early (a newer emit of the same emitter, a Disable,
	      the engine going down, the emitter gone)
	  EmitterBursts.step(dt)
	      advances every running train. Connected to Heartbeat while a train runs; the offline
	      test calls it directly.
	  EmitterBursts.running() -> number of trains
	Rate and TimeScale are read every frame: a Container's Rate graph, or a script, changes the
	spacing of a running train, and time standing still (TimeScale 0) holds it.
	The emitter's Enabled stays off; every particle comes from :Emit. A frame that owes several
	bursts emits them as one call.
	Consumer: Particles.fireEmitter, the one place a native emitter is fired from.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EmitterBursts = {}

-- A train is over this much before its duration: frame times do not add up to it exactly, and
-- the burst that falls on the end itself is not part of the train.
local END_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 1e-6

local trains = {}
local heartbeat = nil

function EmitterBursts.running()
	return #trains
end

function EmitterBursts.step(dt)
	local index = #trains
	while index >= 1 do
		local train = trains[index]
		local ended = not train.stillCurrent()
		if not ended then
			train.elapsed += dt
			ended = train.elapsed >= train.duration - END_TOLERANCE_SECONDS
		end
		if ended then
			trains[index] = trains[#trains]
			trains[#trains] = nil
		else
			local emitter = train.emitter
			train.owed += dt * emitter.Rate * math.clamp(emitter.TimeScale, 0, 1)
			local due = math.floor(train.owed)
			if due > 0 then
				train.owed -= due
				emitter:Emit(train.count * due)
			end
		end
		index -= 1
	end
	if #trains == 0 and heartbeat then
		heartbeat:Disconnect()
		heartbeat = nil
	end
end

function EmitterBursts.start(emitter, count, duration, stillCurrent)
	if count <= 0 then
		return
	end
	emitter:Emit(count)
	if duration <= 0 then
		return
	end
	table.insert(trains, {
		emitter = emitter,
		count = count,
		duration = duration,
		elapsed = 0,
		-- Bursts owed since the last one, as a fraction: Rate * time.
		owed = 0,
		stillCurrent = stillCurrent,
	})
	if not heartbeat then
		heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(EmitterBursts.step)
	end
end

return EmitterBursts
